name: flood-sensors-chesapeake
description: Live public flood sensor readings for six named Chesapeake Bay areas, from Norfolk to Baltimore, at run time. Runs without model keys.

steps.reason: Current water levels and flood categories around Norfolk and the Elizabeth River
Gauges inside the Lafayette River study box shared with the Earth Engine Skills
Current water levels on the Hampton and Newport News waterfront
Current water levels on the lower York River
Current water levels at Annapolis and the Severn River
Current water levels in Baltimore Harbor

gaps: Readings are the latest provisional values at run time, not a time series or a forecast.
Datums differ across NOAA NWPS, CO-OPS and USGS, so values are compared only with each sensor's own thresholds.
Street-level and community sensor networks such as StormSense are not queried.
